items.properties: @{type=; id=; timestamp=; serviceUrl=; channelId=; from=; conversation=; recipient=; membersAdded=; membersRemoved=; reactionsAdded=; reactionsRemoved=; text=; attachments=; entities=; replyToId=; value=; name=; listenFor=; textHighlights=}

inputs.where:
@and(
    equals(item()?['from']?['role'], 'bot'),
    greaterOrEquals(item()?['timestamp'], outputs('Compose:_CurrentTimestamp')),
    empty(first(item()?['attachments'])?['content']?['tokenExchangeResource']?['id']),
    or(
        equals(first(item()?['attachments'])?['contentType'], 'application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive'),
        and(
            not(empty(item()?['text'])), 
            not(
                or(
                    contains(toLower(item()?['text']), 'need you to sign in'),
                    contains(toLower(item()?['text']), 'please sign in'),
                    contains(toLower(item()?['text']), 'sign in to continue'),
                    contains(toLower(item()?['text']), 'log in to access'),
                    contains(toLower(item()?['text']), 'sign-in required'),
                    contains(toLower(item()?['text']), 'click here to log in')
                )
            )
        )
    )
)

parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false" count="300" page="@{variables('PageNumber')}" paging-cookie="@{variables('PagingCookie')}">
  <entity name="conversationtranscript">
    <attribute name="name" />
    <attribute name="content" />
    <attribute name="conversationstarttime" />
    <attribute name="bot_conversationtranscriptid" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="bot_conversationtranscriptid" operator="eq" value="{@{triggerBody()['text']}}" />
     <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
@{triggerBody()['text_2']}
    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>
